Error400.description: Error envelope with one of the codes: invalid_argument, invite_invalid, pairing_code_invalid.

Error401.description: Error envelope with one of the codes: unauthenticated.

Error403.description: Error envelope with one of the codes: not_enrolled, revoked, forbidden, preview_only, not_shared, untrusted_peer, pipe_origin_refused, worker_pending, reauth_required, reauth_unavailable, tls_required, passphrase_invalid, new_sessions_blocked.

Error404.description: Error envelope with one of the codes: not_found, target_not_found.

Error405.description: Error envelope with one of the codes: method_not_allowed.

Error409.description: Error envelope with one of the codes: conflict, pairing_id_collision, already_paired, pane_changed, busy, shell_pane, dialog_open, schema_too_new, no_dialog, dialog_changed, view_incomplete.

Error410.description: Error envelope with one of the codes: invite_expired, invite_exhausted.

Error413.description: Error envelope with one of the codes: frame_too_large, message_too_large.

Error426.description: Error envelope with one of the codes: proto_incompatible.

Error429.description: Error envelope with one of the codes: rate_limited, pairing_attempts_exceeded, pipe_rate_limited, pipe_budget_exceeded.

Error500.description: Error envelope with one of the codes: internal.

Error501.description: Error envelope with one of the codes: unsupported_op.

Error502.description: Error envelope with one of the codes: connection_lost.

Error503.description: Error envelope with one of the codes: worker_offline, hub_cert_expired, paused.

details.description: Always an object, {} when there is nothing.

ErrorCode.description: Every error code; the HTTP status is fixed per code.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The only error shape of the API.

csrfHeader.description: CSRF token of the session; required with the cookie on every method other than GET.
csrfHeader.name: X-Minion-CSRF

info.description: Generated from the operation catalog (internal/ops); do not edit by hand. Every operation is served at POST /api/v1/ops/<name>, and at GET with the arguments in the query string when it does not change state. A success answer is the bare result with HTTP 200; every failure is the error envelope with the HTTP status of its code.
info.title: Minion Hub API

get.summary: Explain why one session can or cannot reach a session on another Worker: every layer in order, and the first one that fails.

post.summary: Explain why one session can or cannot reach a session on another Worker: every layer in order, and the first one that fails.

get.summary: Show which master sessions reach which sessions on other Workers, and the layer that blocks a pair (an admin sees every Worker, others their own).

post.summary: Show which master sessions reach which sessions on other Workers, and the layer that blocks a pair (an admin sees every Worker, others their own).

get.summary: Show your own preferences, such as whether you allow new hidden sessions and which harnesses you want to see, and the Hub policy they depend on.

post.summary: Show your own preferences, such as whether you allow new hidden sessions and which harnesses you want to see, and the Hub policy they depend on.
Change your own preferences, such as allowing new sessions that would be hidden from your terminal (from your own browser session, or with an API key that holds manage).
Act as another user in this browser session for a limited time (admin only, audited).
Stop acting as another user in this browser session.
Disable device control on an Android Worker and close its open streams; it can only be enabled on the device.
Send a validated key event, text, tap or swipe to this Android Worker's device (local sessions only).
Capture the screen of this Android Worker's device as PNG (local sessions only).
Run a non-interactive shell command with shell-uid rights on this Android Worker's own device (local sessions only).

get.summary: Report the device control (on-device adb) status of an Android Worker and its last audit entries.

post.summary: Report the device control (on-device adb) status of an Android Worker and its last audit entries.
Allow or forbid an e-mail link of an IdP identity into an admin account (off by default).
Answer the dialog a session pane shows.

get.summary: Create an API key limited to chosen users, Workers or sessions and actions; the key is shown once.

post.summary: Create an API key limited to chosen users, Workers or sessions and actions; the key is shown once.

get.summary: List API keys with their hint, scope and expiry; never the key itself.

post.summary: List API keys with their hint, scope and expiry; never the key itself.
Revoke an API key at once.

get.summary: List audit log events, newest first.

post.summary: List audit log events, newest first.

get.summary: Explain which master sessions may control a session, or why none can (admin only).

post.summary: Explain which master sessions may control a session, or why none can (admin only).

get.summary: List every Worker's Minion control: user-managed, which Workers it accepts control from, its master sessions (admin only).

post.summary: List every Worker's Minion control: user-managed, which Workers it accepts control from, its master sessions (admin only).
Let a Worker accept control from another Worker's master sessions (optionally only some sessions), or stop it (admin only).
Nominate or revoke a verified terminal incarnation (admin only).
Nominate a session as a master session on its Worker, or make it a slave session again (admin only).
Set whether people and API keys control a Worker (user-managed) and whether it accepts control from all Workers (admin only).
Lift the suspension of a session grant (admin only). Browser session with a fresh sign-in only.
Bind a session grant to the verified terminal of its source session, or unbind it (owner of both Workers or administrator). Browser session with a fresh sign-in only.

get.summary: List the audit events of one session grant, newest first (owner of a Worker it touches or administrator).

post.summary: List the audit events of one session grant, newest first (owner of a Worker it touches or administrator).

get.summary: List the session grants: for an owner the grants that touch their Workers, for an administrator all of them.

post.summary: List the session grants: for an owner the grants that touch their Workers, for an administrator all of them.
Revoke a session grant (owner of a Worker it touches or administrator).
Create a session grant, or change the level, expiry, note or command shell flag of an existing one (owner of the Workers or administrator). Browser session with a fresh sign-in only.

get.summary: Show the Hub's version, uptime, public URL and trusted proxies, how it sees this request (peer, client IP, forwarded headers, effective scheme) and how many Workers are connected.

post.summary: Show the Hub's version, uptime, public URL and trusted proxies, how it sees this request (peer, client IP, forwarded headers, effective scheme) and how many Workers are connected.
Seal the same root under a new passphrase; no certificate, key or Worker session changes. Browser session with a fresh sign-in only.
Issue a new operational key and certificate under the same root; all Worker sessions close and reconnect. Browser session with a fresh sign-in only.

Rotate the master key: a new root under a new passphrase, a transition signed by the old root, all invitations revoked; Workers follow the chain without re-pairing. Browser session with a fresh sign-in only.
Set the Hub passphrase: seal the root under it and issue the first certificate (only while no sealed root exists). Browser session with a fresh sign-in only.

get.summary: Show the state of the Hub identity: bootstrap state, root fingerprint, certificate serial and validity, expiry warning and the passphrase lockout state. It needs no passphrase.

post.summary: Show the state of the Hub identity: bootstrap state, root fingerprint, certificate serial and validity, expiry warning and the passphrase lockout state. It needs no passphrase.
Replace the Hub container with the newest signed release in its update channel (Docker, opt-in; admin only).

get.summary: Show the Hub's release, the newest one in its update channel, and whether the Hub can update itself (admin only).

post.summary: Show the Hub's release, the newest one in its update channel, and whether the Hub can update itself (admin only).
Set the owner-installed Hub host updater policy (administrator browser session only).
Ask GitHub now for the newest release in the Hub's update channel (at most once a minute) and report like hub_update_check (admin only).
Detach an IdP identity from an account: its IdP roles and sessions end, the account stays.

get.summary: List the IdP identities linked to accounts, for one account or for all.

post.summary: List the IdP identities linked to accounts, for one account or for all.
Create an invitation key for enrolling Workers; the key is shown once.

get.summary: List invitation keys with uses, expiry and state.

post.summary: List invitation keys with uses, expiry and state.
Revoke an invitation key so that no further Worker can enroll with it.

get.summary: List the e-mail linking policy of the OIDC providers.

post.summary: List the e-mail linking policy of the OIDC providers.
Set whether a provider may link a first sign-in to a local account by e-mail, for which domains, and whether a separate account is created instead of refusing.

get.summary: List the OIDC providers with their role rules and whether TLS verification is off.

post.summary: List the OIDC providers with their role rules and whether TLS verification is off.
Create, replace or delete an OIDC provider set in the panel.
Enter the pairing code a Worker shows, so that the Worker appears in your space as a private Worker.
Admit a waiting Worker without its code; it joins your space approved. Admit only if the Worker's console shows this Worker fingerprint and this Hub's fingerprint words (admin only).
Reject a waiting Worker's pairing request; the Worker shows that it was rejected and a new code (admin only).

get.summary: List the Workers that wait with a pairing code and can be admitted without it: name, source address, waiting since, the Worker fingerprint and the public pairing id (admin only).

post.summary: List the Workers that wait with a pairing code and can be admitted without it: name, source address, waiting since, the Worker fingerprint and the public pairing id (admin only).
Change your own password: the old one is verified and your other sessions end.

get.summary: Read the stored pipe turns of a session.

post.summary: Read the stored pipe turns of a session.
Send a pipe message to an agent session: it is pasted and submitted with Enter.

get.summary: Stream the next pipe turns of a session as they arrive.

200.description: A stream of results, one JSON document per line.

post.summary: Stream the next pipe turns of a session as they arrive.
Set the claim values that give the admin or user role for a panel OIDC provider.
Send named keys to a session pane.
Type text into a session pane. No Enter is added unless submit is true.

get.summary: Return scrollback lines of a session pane.

post.summary: Return scrollback lines of a session pane.

get.summary: List the session-control grants: which controller session may reach which Workers and sessions.

post.summary: List the session-control grants: which controller session may reach which Workers and sessions.
Set the targets a controller session may reach (everything, or Workers and sessions); empty targets remove the grant.
Create a detached session, named minion-N unless a name is given.

get.summary: Return the visible screen of a session pane.

post.summary: Return the visible screen of a session pane.

get.summary: List the sessions the Worker shares.

post.summary: List the sessions the Worker shares.
Set the task text of a session.

get.summary: List the Hub settings with their effective value, source and whether the panel may change them.

post.summary: List the Hub settings with their effective value, source and whether the panel may change them.
Set or unset a Hub setting in the panel unless the environment sets it; changes sets several at once, all or nothing.

get.summary: Show the share rule of a Worker and the names of the sessions it does not share.

post.summary: Show the share rule of a Worker and the names of the sessions it does not share.
Set the share rule of a Worker: all, none, or select with the session names to share.

get.summary: List the Workers and sessions you trust.

post.summary: List the Workers and sessions you trust.
Mark a Worker or session as a trusted source for yourself, or remove the mark.
Set your private display name and order for a provider account.

get.summary: List your private usage buckets.

post.summary: List your private usage buckets.
Save, reorder, delete or assign members to your private usage buckets.
Choose an available Worker or passive session source for this subscription account.

get.summary: Read authorized Worker, session or account usage statistics, including metadata for unshared sessions on your Workers.

post.summary: Read authorized Worker, session or account usage statistics, including metadata for unshared sessions on your Workers.

get.summary: Administrators: show the Hub-wide published usage slots and who published them.

post.summary: Administrators: show the Hub-wide published usage slots and who published them.
Publish one of your usage buckets to your Workers, or to every Worker of the Hub (administrators with manage), or withdraw a slot.
Allow or refuse that buckets published by others include observations of your own sessions and accounts (default refuse).

get.summary: Preview the nominated usage document your Workers receive: the Hub-wide pair and your own pair. Labels are plain untrusted text; no session names, folders, account labels or member ids.

post.summary: Preview the nominated usage document your Workers receive: the Hub-wide pair and your own pair. Labels are plain untrusted text; no session names, folders, account labels or member ids.
Create a local account with a generated temporary password that is shown once.
Deactivate an account: it cannot sign in, its sessions and API keys end and its Workers stay with it.
Set a new temporary password for a local account and sign the user out everywhere.
Give an account that signs in through an IdP a local temporary password, shown once, and optionally an e-mail address.
Grant or remove the local admin role of an account.

get.summary: List the accounts with their role, state and whether the password is temporary.

post.summary: List the accounts with their role, state and whether the password is temporary.
Approve a pending Worker so that the Hub routes operations to it and accepts its calls; compare the fingerprint, name and source address first.
Switch debug logging of a Worker on for a while (default 60 minutes, at most 1440) or off; the Worker must allow it (allow_debug_remote).
Allow or refuse new hidden sessions on one Worker, or return it to each caller's account preference (the owner on their own Workers, an administrator on any Worker).
Read the most recent lines of a Worker's log from its memory (default 500, at most 2000); the Worker must allow it (allow_debug_remote).
Re-issue pairing for a Worker that never connected: for 10 minutes the next new pairing code of that Worker completes the pairing for the same Worker row.
Reassign an infrastructure Worker to another user (admin only); trust is dropped and bound keys are revoked.
Remove a Worker: it becomes a tombstone, its trust and bound API keys are deleted, and it is told to wipe its pairing.
Rename a Worker; the name must be unique among the owner's Workers.
Restrict a Worker to preview only (or lift the Hub-side restriction); the Worker's local restrictions stay.
Retire the calling Worker's identity: remove its enrollment and leave a tombstone, so that the old key gets a signed revoke on its next connect.
Ask a Worker to install an exact signed release and restart (admin only); it answers at once and updates in the background.
